$$
\begin{aligned}
  \operatorname{Percent Organic Seed}_{i}  &\sim N \left(\mu, \sigma^2 \right) \\
    \mu &=\alpha_{j[i],k[i],l[i]} + \beta_{1}(\operatorname{Values}) + \beta_{2}(\operatorname{Acreage}) + \beta_{3}(\operatorname{CertifierRequest}) \\
    \alpha_{j}  &\sim N \left(\gamma_{0}^{\alpha} + \gamma_{1}^{\alpha}(\operatorname{Funding}) + \gamma_{2}^{\alpha}(\operatorname{Growers:Suppliers}) + \gamma_{3}^{\alpha}(\operatorname{Revenue}), \sigma^2_{\alpha_{j}} \right)
    \text{, for Region j = 1,} \dots \text{,J} \\
    \alpha_{k}  &\sim N \left(\mu_{\alpha_{k}}, \sigma^2_{\alpha_{k}} \right)
    \text{, for Year k = 1,} \dots \text{,K} \\
    \alpha_{l}  &\sim N \left(\mu_{\alpha_{l}}, \sigma^2_{\alpha_{l}} \right)
    \text{, for Crop l = 1,} \dots \text{,L}
\end{aligned}
$$
$$
\begin{aligned}
  \operatorname{IncreasedOrganicSeed}_{i}  &\sim \operatorname{Binomial}(n = 1, \operatorname{prob}_{\operatorname{IncreasedOrganicSeed} = 1} = \widehat{P}) \\
    \log\left[\frac{\hat{P}}{1 - \hat{P}} \right] &=\alpha_{j[i],k[i],l[i]} + \beta_{1}(\operatorname{Values}) + \beta_{2}(\operatorname{Acreage}) + \beta_{3}(\operatorname{CertifierRequest}) \\
    \alpha_{j}  &\sim N \left(\gamma_{0}^{\alpha} + \gamma_{1}^{\alpha}(\operatorname{Funding}) + \gamma_{2}^{\alpha}(\operatorname{Growers:Suppliers}) + \gamma_{3}^{\alpha}(\operatorname{Revenue}), \sigma^2_{\alpha_{j}} \right)
    \text{, for Region j = 1,} \dots \text{,J} \\
    \alpha_{k}  &\sim N \left(\mu_{\alpha_{k}}, \sigma^2_{\alpha_{k}} \right)
    \text{, for Year k = 1,} \dots \text{,K} \\
    \alpha_{l}  &\sim N \left(\mu_{\alpha_{l}}, \sigma^2_{\alpha_{l}} \right)
    \text{, for Crop l = 1,} \dots \text{,L}
\end{aligned}
$$
